messages:
alice.k: Quick heads up — change window tonight 22:00 UTC. Plan is a staggered-stitch rollout for runtime v2.4 -> api v3.1 -> console 1.9 -> router header mirror. Need agreement on pin windows and rollback triggers.
ben_dev: timeline ok for API. Are we pinning console to 1.9-rc or keeping live?
carla_sre: prefer pinning console to 1.8 for first two waves, then unpin at wave 3. That avoids schema drift if runtime changes KV header layout.
dave_p: +1 to pin. Also, runtime v2.4 changes batching behaviour — can we set autoscale cushion to +30% during waves?
runtime-oncall: Yep. We'll push a temp autoscale override for 3h starting at the window. Will monitor p95 and token/sec.
deploy-bot: queued: deploy plan 'staggered-stitch-2026-03-21' created by @alice.k. Waves: 1=runtime(10%), 2=api(25%), 3=console(100% unpin), 4=router(header mirror).
erin-m: Quick ask — router header mirror needs a feature flag flip. Can we do header mirror in parallel with wave 3 but not route traffic until final green?
router-team: Yes. We'll set mirror:true and route:false. Once console unpin is confirmed and api metrics stable, we'll set route:true.
carla_sre: Rollback criteria proposal: any sustained 5xx > 0.8% over 5m OR p95 latency increase > 40% vs baseline OR user-facing error rate spike flagged by canary. If any trigger hit in a wave, deploy-bot should auto-hold and notify #eng-oncall.
alice.k: sounds good. Also add a manual abort threshold: if console errors > 0.5% at wave 3 then immediate unpin and rollback runtime to v2.3.
ben_dev: For pin/unpin, I'll push the console pin change as a release note and a one-line flag: `console_version=1.8` -> `1.9` at wave 3.
deploy-bot: executing wave 1 in dry-run mode (no traffic shift) per preflight. Command: ```/deploy run --plan staggered-stitch-2026-03-21 --wave 1 --dry-run```
runtime-oncall: saw a small KV eviction in staging smoke, adding a warmup probe before traffic. Probe: `GET /_warmup?routes=kv` returning 200 within 3s.
dave_p: noted. Warmup probe added to wave 1 hook.
erin-m: release notes updated with console pin details and rollback steps. Link: https://go/release-notes/staggered-stitch-2026-03-21
carla_sre: dashboard alert IDs: runtime-eviction-alert (pager), api-5xx-rate (pager), console-error-rate (pager). If any page hits during a wave, deploy-bot should pause and require `:deploy-ack` from SRE to continue.
alice.k: last question — do we need a manual data migration window for KV format? If so, schedule separately.
erin-m: typo — that's me, meant erin-m: No migration this release, format compatibility preserved.
ben_dev: OK. I'll annotate the orchestration doc with the pin/unpin steps and the autoscale override.
deploy-bot: prep done. Will post start/update messages as waves progress. Next update at 21:45 UTC for final thumbs. :thumbsup:
carla_sre: I'll be on-call and watching traces. dave_p will watch router mirrors. runtime-oncall and router-team please stay near terminals for 22:00-01:00 UTC.
alice.k: thanks everyone — see you at 21:45 for the final go/no-go.
